subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw bracketed button JSON in model final text as a fallback for Gemini, or require Gemini/provider prompting to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the structured-only gap, but the proposed parser changes the product contract for model-visible final text and Telegram presentation mapping.

options.title: Accept A Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on provider/tool prompting so Gemini uses structured message-tool buttons.

options.title: Hold For Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not accept implementation work until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept A Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses typed presentation, Telegram button rendering, and product behavior boundaries where history and the live PR review request point to steipete.
